summary: Pull A day. Breakfast is pure grab-and-go (today's wellness-bar Banana Chai Protein Smoothie, bagel, a hard-boiled egg, berries) since he keeps skipping it or swapping in just the smoothie - this honors that pattern while still hitting protein. Lunch brings in Creamy Chicken Pasta for variety. Dinner switches to Mary's Soy Lemongrass Chicken (new dish) since Shoyu Chicken was just last night's dinner.
